name: Extrac32.exe
description: Extract to ADS, copy or overwrite a file with Extrac32.exe
author: Oddvar Moe

commands.description: Extracts the source CAB file into an Alternate Data Stream (ADS) of the target file.
commands.usecase: Extract data from cab file and hide it in an alternate data stream.
commands.os: Windows XP, Windows Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

commands.usecase: Extract data from cab file and hide it in an alternate data stream.
commands.os: Windows XP, Windows Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

commands.description: Copy the source file to the destination file and overwrite it.
